transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I'm here because... I just can't seem to keep myself together lately. My daughter left for basic training recently, and ever since she left, I feel like I just come home to a dead house. 

It's really affecting my day-to-day. I find myself sitting out in my truck crying before my shifts start. I'm a sheet metal worker, and lately I'm missing steps on welding jobs I’ve done for years, and I keep snapping at the younger guys on the crew. Outside of work, I've completely stopped going out on the water or working on my metal sculptures. I just... I don’t see the point right now.
How long has it been since you started feeling this way—crying, losing interest in things, and having trouble at work?
It's been about a month. She left for basic training four weeks ago, and... well, I've been struggling with all of this pretty much ever since then.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep or appetite since your daughter left?

Not really, no. I mean, I'm still eating about the same. I pack my lunch for the site just like always, and I eat dinner. And my sleep is... well, it's fine. I sleep through the night for the most part. So, no, I haven't really noticed any changes with either of those. It's just everything else that feels like it's falling apart.

Do you notice this sadness and loss of interest sticking with you throughout most of the day, even at times when you're not specifically thinking about your daughter, or does it mainly come up when something reminds you of her?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really paid attention to exactly when it hits me. I mean... I don't know if it's just hanging over me all day long or if it only happens when something reminds me of her. I just haven't really noticed a pattern like that.
Have there been any moments this past month—maybe a good day at work or time with friends—when you felt genuinely okay or even happy, even briefly?

No, I don't think so. I can't really remember a time this past month where I felt... genuinely okay or happy. Work has just been a struggle, and I haven't really been hanging out with anyone. So, no, I haven't had any moments like that.
Over this past month, have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or that you'd be better off not being here?

No, I haven't had any thoughts like that. I mean, I feel miserable, but... I don't want to hurt myself or anything. I definitely don't think about not being here. It's just really hard getting through the days right now. But no, nothing like that.
Over this past month, have you noticed trouble concentrating or making decisions, like feeling more distracted or indecisive than usual at work or at home?
No, not really. I mean... I can still focus on what I need to do. Making decisions hasn't been a problem, either. I haven't noticed being any more distracted than usual, no.
Over this past month, have you found yourself feeling worthless, or feeling excessively guilty about things, even things that aren't really your fault?

No, I don't think I've felt worthless. I mean, I feel awful, and I'm really struggling to just get by, but I don't feel like I'm a bad person or anything. And I haven't really been feeling guilty, either. Just... really overwhelmed and sad. But not guilty or worthless, no.
